life recently

hello sitely brothers here are my thoughts for the next unknown amount of time

life recently has been... super duper busy. last month (may) was my last month of school and so EVERYTHING had to be put on hold just so i could make sure that i made it until the end of my junior year. yikes was this one rough. but anyways - inbetween my track schedule, my friends wanting to kickstart summer, and just the general end of school, i was HELLA busy. but i'm here now! i'm officially on summer break. however, mon-wed-fri i have volleyball practice which is yucky. usually we have it in the morning but because one of our coach's work schedules we have to move it into the afternoon. so the plus side is that i get to sleep in, with the downside being that my evening/afternoon is cut a bit short because of ew gross sweaty tired volleyball practice.

so i've gotten back into actually working on my site rather than just doing weekly housekeeping. it feels good ! i love being able to get back into the creative flow of things, which leads me into..
